primary-key.description: Indigo seed. Primary role uses tone 40.

tertiary-key.description: Indigo at medium chroma (32). Monochromatic scheme.

neutral-key.description: Indigo hue at chroma 2. Surfaces and text.

neutral-variant-key.description: Indigo hue at chroma 4. Outlines and secondary text.

pending-key.description: Provisional access, pending confirmation. Role pins this key, which is tone 44.

success-key.description: Active, paid, allowed. Role pins this key, which is tone 45.

chart-1.description: First series. Indigo. Charts only, never status.

chart-2.description: Second series. Teal blue, clear of success green. Charts only, never status.

chart-3.description: Third series. Violet. Charts only, never status.

chart-4.description: Fourth series or "other". Grey. Charts only, never status.

chart-5.description: Target lines and highlights. Light indigo. Charts only, never status.

primary.description: Main buttons, active nav, links, focus ring. One filled primary button per screen.

secondary.description: Main secondary fill. Text on it uses on-secondary.

tertiary.description: Main tertiary fill. Text on it uses on-tertiary.

error.description: Expired plan, check-in denied, payment failed. Never decoration.

error-container.description: Banner and soft badge background for error.

pending-container.description: Banner and soft badge background for pending.

success.description: Active plan, paid invoice, check-in allowed.

success-container.description: Banner and soft badge background for success.

surface-container-high.description: Hover on low containers, search fields.

outline-variant.description: Dividers and card borders. Decorative only.

fontSize.description: Below 600px wide. Marketing hero, big money totals.
Below 600px wide. Key figures on cards.

font-family.description: Self-hosted variable font, Latin subset, weights 400 to 600, font-display swap.

target-min.description: Smallest tap area for any control.

control-height-expanded.description: Buttons and inputs from 840px. Tap area stays 48 on touch screens.

control-height-small.description: Filter chips and small buttons. Pad the tap area to 48.

compact.description: Phone. One column. Sidebar becomes a top bar. Compact type and spacing.

medium.description: Tablet. Two columns where they fit.

expanded.description: Laptop. Sidebar and content side by side. Expanded spacing.

state-hover.description: Overlay of the content colour on hover.

disabled-content.description: Text and icons of a disabled control.

icon-set.description: Outline icons only. Import each icon on its own, never the whole set.
